$comment: See de.json. reasonsFar: wording when a reason has no distance because nothing of that kind is within reach. warningsUnnamed: wording when OSM has no name for the area.

warnings.residential_too_close: Only {distance} to the nearest residential or recreational area – EU category A3 generally requires {limit}.
warnings.protected_strict: Inside the nature reserve “{name}” – drone flights are prohibited there.
warnings.protected_national_park: Inside the national park “{name}” – drone flights are prohibited there.
warnings.protected_bird: Inside the bird protection area “{name}” – drone flights are prohibited there.
warnings.protected_ffh: Inside the habitats area “{name}” (Natura 2000) – drone flights are prohibited there.
warnings.protected_natura2000: Inside the Natura 2000 site “{name}” (habitats or bird protection) – drone flights are prohibited there.
warnings.protected_landscape: Inside the landscape protection area “{name}” – check the local rules.
warnings.aerodrome_too_close: Only {distance} to “{name}” – check the control zone!
warnings.power_too_close: Power line or pylon {distance} away – wires are barely visible in FPV.
warnings.road_too_close: Road only {distance} away – too close for safe operation.
warnings.under_trees: Right at or under trees – poor launch spot, check your video link.
warnings.tree_line_near: Tree line {distance} away – good to fly around, but mind the obstacles.
warnings.path_near: Path {distance} away – expect walkers and cyclists.
warnings.strava_busy: The Strava heatmap shows a heavily used route here.
warnings.strava_moderate: The Strava heatmap shows moderate activity.
warnings.farmland: Arable field: mind right of way and standing crops (harmless outside the growing season).
warnings.on_water: This point sits on water – no launch spot.

reasons.little_strava_activity: Hardly any activity on the Strava heatmap

errors.outside_coverage: This place is outside Germany – the finder covers Germany only.
errors.osm_unavailable: Map data is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.geocoder_unavailable: Place search is unavailable right now. Try “My location” instead.
errors.busy: Lots of people are searching right now. Please try again in half a minute.
errors.rate_limited: Too many searches in a short time. Please wait a moment.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

share.title: {category} · score {score}/100
share.description: FPV spot scoring {score}/100: {reasons}. Check the rules before flying, e.g. on dipul.de.
share.note: The score is based on open map data and is not an airspace check. Verify the rules before flying, e.g. on dipul.de.
share.noWarnings: Nothing notable in the map data.

regionPage.title: FPV spots around {city} – quiet places to fly | FPV Flying Spot Finder
regionPage.description: {good} good FPV spots within {r} km of {city}: with reasons, warnings and a direct link into the finder. Free, no sign-up.
regionPage.lead: Within {r} km of {city} the finder rated {points} places. {good} of them score at least 70 out of 100. {blocked} % are ruled out by residential areas, roads, railways, protected areas or airfields.
regionPage.reserves: There are nature and bird protection areas nearby, for example {names}. Leisure drone flights are prohibited there.
regionPage.aerodromes: Airfields nearby: {names}. Keep 1.5 km from airfields and 1 km from airports; control zones only with clearance.
regionPage.always: Check the geographical zones on dipul.de before flying, and get the landowner's permission to take off or land on private land.
regionPage.guides: More in the guide “Where can I fly FPV in Germany?”.
regionPage.dataNote: Computed on {date} from OpenStreetMap data (as of {data}), time profile weekend afternoon. The spots are suggestions from map data and do not replace a check on site.
regionPage.indexTitle: FPV spots by region – large cities in Germany | FPV Flying Spot Finder
regionPage.indexDescription: Quiet FPV spots around {count} large German cities, computed from open map data – with reasons and warnings.
regionPage.indexLead: For each region the finder searched a 10 km radius. Regions with too few good spots get no page of their own.
regionPage.empty: The region pages are being computed. Until then, find spots directly in the finder.
